g.text: Actual trace compression: moments, signs and the original path
Full-state identities and evaluated sufficient thresholds [JTR1–JTR10]
κ* = 4/5; a = 1/(100j), L = j⁴, b = 1/(κ*a²), sⱼ = κ*/j; raw ξ = 7/3 retained.
The plot evaluates the complete bound formulas at 180 digits, not the actual state spectrum.
The sufficient threshold grows while the intended shift shrinks; its full coefficient is proved in JTR10.
